rows.title: Credits vs USDC vs reputation: issuance, precision, fees, conversion, labels
rows.observed: Traced in source: credits = faucet-minted double-entry ledger, whole credits, MAX_TOPUP 10000, no fee, no purchase/redemption/withdrawal; USDC = separate escrow ledger, 6-decimal integer units, fee ceil(reward*bps/10000), default 1000 bps, only on approved tests, unused rewards+fees refunded on close; settlement modes off|simulated|squads_devnet, production config refuses all but off; hosted runs env staging + simulated; reputation = append-only points for accepted work only, no cash value, quality-ranked opt-in leaderboard. No exchange rate exists.

rows.title: How hosted builders get credits (trace)
rows.steps: Source and live-config trace: packages/contracts CREDITS_DISCLAIMER; packages/domain/src/ledger.ts planTopUp/MAX_TOPUP; apps/api handlers/account.ts topUp (feature gate); apps/mobile/src/screens/CreditsScreen.tsx topUp mutation; live /api/config testCredits=true
rows.observed: Hosted builders mint TEST CREDITS themselves: POST /api/me/credits/test-topup {amount} (builder only), whole number 1..10000 per top-up (MAX_TOPUP), posted faucet 'system:test-faucet' → 'user:<id>' as an append-only double-entry pair; available because testCredits=true on the live config (production would refuse: 'Test credits aren’t available on this deployment. Funding with real money isn’t enabled yet.'). UI: the Budget/Credits screen top-up card. Labelled 'Test credits · no cash value'. No purchase, redemption or withdrawal exists. Wallet-escrow studies (simulated) are funded through POST /api/studies/:id/escrow/fundings + /api/escrow/fundings/:id/simulated-wallet-payment (no wallet charged).
rows.notes: All amounts are simulated bookkeeping (test credits 'no cash value'; hosted settlement=simulated), never money. Live execution of a top-up is H-16 (BLOCKED).
